init.title: Smart Solity options
init.description: Event-log polling (5-600s) reads the cloud log — it does NOT wake the lock, so it can be fast. Status polling (1-1440 min) wakes the lock for battery/deadbolt, so keep it slow. The lock state is the real deadbolt: after every open the lock is re-polled a few times (3s, 8s, 15s, … up to 15 min) until the motor has locked again.
